description: YouTube transcript API for AI agents: send a video URL or 11-character id and get its published subtitles as timed JSON segments, plain text, SRT or WebVTT, with title, channel, duration, views and publish date. Choose one of ten subtitle languages or any. No speech-to-text. A video without subtitles in that language is not charged. Not offered on Solana: pay on Base or Polygon.

format.description: json: timed segments in transcript; text, srt or vtt: the transcript as one string

lang.description: subtitle language; any takes English if the video has it, else the first track

video.description: one video: an 11-character video id, or a watch, shorts, live, embed or youtu.be URL of one video (not a channel, playlist or search)

name: youtube-transcript
title: YouTube transcript of a video
